why_ai: Selling seats, rooms and campsites as agent is screen work that platforms automate, though pricing and onsale calls are adversarial judgements under fan and regulator scrutiny.
why_clarity: A sold seat, a settled show and a resale price are exact, recur millions of times and are graded within hours, though scaling is done by feel.
why_digital: Inventory, sales and mobile tickets are digital, but venue and team contracts are still won through relationships and in-person pitches.

why_ai: Winning a multi-year venue contract rests on relationships and negotiation that the antitrust remedies will reshape, not on anything an AI tool replaces.
why_clarity: Yield per seat is measurable, but contracts are compared on bundled terms and recur only every five to seven years per venue.
why_digital: Sales data and service are digital; the contract is negotiated face to face with venue owners and managers.

why_ai: Each onsale is a high-stakes, adversarial event where the artist's price ceiling and fan anger make the final call a human one.
why_clarity: Tickets reaching fans and resale leakage are measurable within hours, but scaling and release are done by feel and differ by director.
why_digital: Onsales, queues and delivery are fully digital; promoters choose ticketers through relationships at the tour level.

why_ai: Renewal risk scoring automates, but saving a long-time member still depends on a rep's relationship and the team's results.
why_clarity: Renewal is a clear yes or no, but it arrives once a season and is moved by on-field results nobody controls.
why_digital: Scan, transfer and CRM data are digital; retention calls and seat visits stay personal and local.

why_ai: Listing checks, delivery tracking and guarantees are platform operations that software and AI agents already run.
why_clarity: Delivered or not, chargeback or not, are objective outcomes over millions of near-identical orders.
why_digital: Listings, payments and mobile transfers are entirely online, sold to remote buyers and brokers.

why_ai: Will call and settlement happen in the building with an accountable treasurer whose count the promoter and tour must trust.
why_clarity: A settlement either balances to the seat or it does not, the steps are fixed, and the check is immediate.
why_digital: Holds live in software, but requests arrive by text and the settlement is signed in a room at the venue.

why_ai: Matching deposits to requests and explaining values are routine service tasks that AI agents and booking software can take on.
why_clarity: Matches are exact and recur at volume, though whether a value was fair is disputed and match outcomes can take months.
why_digital: Inventory and booking are digital, but many older members still deposit and search by phone.

why_ai: A small box office also runs the house and knows its regular patrons, a relationship-driven role that tools support rather than replace.
why_clarity: Returning visits are countable, but what brings a patron back is partly taste and shows up only next season.
why_digital: Ticketing and email are digital, but walk-ups, phone sales and the front-of-house welcome are in person and local.

why_ai: Booking, release rules and bot detection are software problems the contractors and AI tools can automate.
why_clarity: Bookings repeat by the million, but fairness of allocation has no agreed definition and is judged by complaints.
why_digital: Booking is online; the agencies buy systems through public procurement with state-level preferences.

why_ai: An adversarial arms race against AI-assisted bots, now with BOTS Act enforcement attached, keeps judgement and accountability in demand.
why_clarity: Every onsale repeats the task, but whether a cluster is one broker is confirmed only slowly and partly.
why_digital: Telemetry, accounts and decisions are entirely digital, sold remotely to platforms.

why_ai: Applying refund policy and assembling dispute evidence are rule-bound tasks that AI agents absorb directly.
why_clarity: Refund issued, dispute won or lost: the rules are written and the outcomes are objective and recur at scale.
why_digital: Orders, refunds and disputes are processed and communicated entirely online.

why_ai: Ranking, pricing and risk models are built on the marketplace's own data with standard machine-learning tooling.
why_clarity: Price and delivery predictions are checked against sold prices and outcomes within days, over millions of orders.
why_digital: Marketplace logs in, models and dashboards out, all online.

why_ai: Fraud decisions face adaptive adversaries, but the vendors' own work is model building that AI-native competitors can replicate.
why_clarity: Approve or decline decisions are graded by chargebacks within weeks over huge volumes.
why_digital: Transaction data in, decisions and dispute files out, sold remotely to merchants.

why_ai: Teams buy the consultant's judgement and relationships as well as models, which keeps the work partly protected.
why_clarity: Pricing and renewal advice recurs every season and is checked against renewals, but each client differs.
why_digital: Client data in, recommendations out, with on-site workshops and relationship selling.

why_ai: Pricing and fan-protection models are internal engineering work, protected mainly by the platform's scale.
why_clarity: Onsale forecasts are graded within hours by sales and resale prices, across thousands of events.
why_digital: Entirely digital data, models and client dashboards.

why_ai: Underwriting is regulated and carries accountability, though pricing and claims triage automate.
why_clarity: Premiums and claims follow written rules over many similar policies, with losses known after each event.
why_digital: Policies are sold and claimed online at checkout.

why_ai: Repricing rules and dashboards are exactly what AI-native tools and marketplace-owned software already provide.
why_clarity: Price recommendations recur daily and are checked against sales quickly.
why_digital: Software and data sold and delivered entirely online.

why_ai: Adversaries adapt constantly and use AI themselves, so demand for expert threat research grows rather than shrinks.
why_clarity: Threat signatures recur, but whether a new bot family is caught is known only after the next onsale.
why_digital: Traffic telemetry in, detection models out, all delivered as cloud services.

why_ai: Valuation and inventory forecasting are model-driven work on the exchange's own data.
why_clarity: Deposit values and match forecasts recur at volume, but fairness is disputed and matches resolve slowly.
why_digital: Member transactions in, pricing and reports out, on screens.

why_ai: Public contracts carry accountability and switching costs, though the reporting itself automates.
why_clarity: Usage reports are exact and repeat each cycle, but allocation quality is not measured.
why_digital: Systems and reports are digital; contracts are won through state and federal procurement.

why_ai: Compiling submitted grosses into charts is routine, though the publication's standing with promoters keeps reports coming in.
why_clarity: Grosses are exact figures compiled weekly, but they are self-reported and rarely checked.
why_digital: Reports arrive and are published online.

why_ai: Associations sell convening and advocacy, which members still pay a body to do in person.
why_clarity: Studies and positions recur yearly, but their success is political and hard to check.
why_digital: Research is digital, but conferences and lobbying are in person.

why_ai: Clients hire a specific advisor's judgement in negotiations, though pricing analysis itself automates.
why_clarity: Each engagement differs, and whether advice raised yield shows only over seasons.
why_digital: Analysis is on screens; advisors are hired through referral and meet clients on site.

why_ai: Access deals depend on relationships with promoters, though presale operations automate.
why_clarity: Deals repeat by tour, but their value to card acquisition is measured loosely.
why_digital: Presales run online; the access deals are negotiated in person with promoters.

why_ai: Enforcement is a statutory power exercised by accountable officials in contested cases, and demand grows as resale laws multiply, though no buyer pays for a particular person.
why_clarity: Statutes define violations, but each case is contested and resolved over years.
why_digital: Investigation is document-heavy and digital, but enforcement happens through courts and in person.
